To improve, focus on organizing your thoughts and using more professional vocabulary to describe your skills and experiences.
suggestions: Practice answering behavioral questions using the STAR method to improve structure

better_answer_example: As a final-year data science undergraduate, I'm excited about the opportunity to apply my skills in data analysis. In my recent project, a job portal prototype, I worked with a team to create reports and implement data visualization using Power BI. This experience not only honed my technical skills but also taught me the importance of teamwork and meeting deadlines. I believe my passion for data science, combined with my eagerness to learn and grow, makes me a strong fit for this role.
